title: carduus laniflorus
intro: Carduus laniflorus, commonly known as Woolly Thistle, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. This plant is used for its health benefits, particularly in treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and supporting liver health. The therapeutic actions of Carduus laniflorus include its ability to act as a choleretic, increasing bile production, and its antispasmodic properties, which help to alleviate muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Carduus laniflorus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
